summary: BLEnder fix(joi): dedupe joi to a single 17.13.8 copy in yarn.lock
description:
The bump left two joi versions in yarn.lock: workspaces got 17.13.8 while
celebrate, @hapi/catbox-redis and @types/hapi stayed on 17.13.7. Joi asserts
"Cannot mix different versions of joi schemas" when schemas from different
copies are combined. Ran yarn dedupe joi so all ranges resolve to 17.13.8.
